curation: AI-assisted summaries; explicit local artifact pins. Updating a pin requires reviewing the changed artifact. No automatic discovery, execution or remote fetching.

updates.title: The full restoration goals
updates.result: Restore natural tooth substance and form, gums, living attachment, sensation and stable position after temporary support; pursue durable youthful function throughout the body.
updates.boundary: These are research objectives. Photos constrain visible form but do not uniquely recover hidden tooth thickness or internal damage.
updates.next_step: Keep every required tissue and function visible when choosing a narrower experiment.

updates.title: Dental bulk resistance and host attachment need separate measurements
updates.result: Reanalyzed 14 listed crack-resistance curves, three contact-fatigue traces and three brushing-roughness summary pairs from the HEA workbook. Roughness worsens in all three material summaries.
updates.boundary: Listed traces and serial points do not identify independent specimens. Bulk response and the separate delamination traces do not link actual repair thickness to host-interface fatigue or clinical durability.
updates.next_step: Connect measured regional thickness, host-junction behavior and retained-tooth damage under repeated loading on the same physical specimen.

artifacts.label: Read the material and interface analysis

updates.title: Construct contraction is distinct from native ligament mechanics
updates.result: Recomputed 777 micrometers of construct shortening and all six native-human tensile summary rows. Native summary moduli change across coupled force and loading-rate regimes.
updates.boundary: Force and shortening in the construct are algebraically linked. Active contraction and passive modulus cannot establish equivalent tissue function, donor-age effects, regenerated bilateral attachment or stable tooth position.
updates.next_step: Link donor identity, construct geometry, both mineralized insertion interfaces, passive response and measured recovery before testing age-by-niche effects.

updates.title: MOTS-c persistence claims depend on what the assay measures
updates.result: Qualified a primary ELISA/LC-MS disagreement and the K14Q steady-state comparison, preserving its variant-specific plasma calibration. None of the four bounded source contexts qualifies as administered-parent concentration-time PK.
updates.boundary: Signal-to-detection-limit scale separation is not true concentration or universal assay failure. One steady-state immunoreactive measurement does not identify intact-parent half-life or oral availability; donor-linked repair data remain unavailable.
updates.next_step: Resolve intact administered parent, endogenous background and products, then connect exposure with the intended donor-stratified repair function.

artifacts.label: See assay and PK eligibility results

updates.title: 48 teeth, with unresolved specimen identities
updates.result: Analyzed 384 optical-margin rows and 48 fracture records. Thirty-seven teeth have internally consistent links; adverse joint-outcome bounds retain all 48.
updates.boundary: Eleven teeth have identity uncertainty. Deposited low load and blank margin fields stay unchanged. Preparation depth is nominal; these are extracted restored teeth, not regenerated tissue.
updates.next_step: Add measured regional repair thickness and valid same-specimen histories while preserving the remaining tooth under loading.

updates.title: Age support changes the gingival trend
updates.result: The full-cohort conflict spans nearly every fixed ECM gene. Restricting the bulk cohort to younger ages reverses its direction; shared-decade analysis preserves the earlier opposition.
updates.boundary: The common-span restriction removes every bulk donor over 45. These subsets are not matched-age or matched-donor validation, and expression is not restored function.
updates.next_step: Seek matched-donor bulk/cell-resolved measurements with qualified sampling sites and independent functional outcomes.

artifacts.label: Read the gene and age-support challenge

updates.title: Selective signaling has not established reproductive protection
updates.result: Original paired data reproduce DL001 selectivity: 433.38 as the mean of paired ratios, versus 350.24 as the ratio of means. The apparent discrepancy is resolved.
updates.boundary: Different assay states, unequal tissue responses and unmatched blood contexts remain. There is no direct DL001 reproductive-protection comparison or established healthy-human testicular-volume inference.
updates.next_step: Specify useful function to retain and require same-context relevant-cell exposure plus direct reproductive outcomes.

updates.title: What the measured dental material data show
updates.result: Recomputed 75 stored source positions. Apparent toughness improves over acid-etched enamel but remains below the native mean; enamel wear directions are unfavorable.
updates.boundary: Source positions are not independent donors. Actual repair-depth and interface measurements are not linked to these specimen outcomes.
updates.next_step: Find specimen-linked depth, crack, leakage and fatigue observations.

updates.title: Keep dental depth and failures connected
updates.result: The analysis preserves specimen/tooth/donor nesting, missing leakage and censored fatigue outcomes. The linked examples are synthetic.
updates.boundary: The real 75-position source extract supplies zero identifiable linked specimens. Software examples are not regenerated tissue or material performance measurements.
updates.next_step: Apply the bridge to an eligible registered specimen series while keeping unknown targets and missing outcomes visible.

updates.title: Cell composition does not yet explain the age disagreement
updates.result: Structural-ECM age slopes stay positive in observed and common-RNA partial mixtures, opposing the earlier bulk-tissue direction.
updates.boundary: The retained groups cover 99.55% of captured cells, but omitted RNA is unknown. This is not reconstructed whole tissue or a biological-age clock.
updates.next_step: Read the follow-up gene/age-support challenge, then seek matched-donor bulk and cell-resolved measurements.

updates.title: SS-31: intact exposure and material accounting
updates.result: Separated intact parent from metabolites, reproduced 21 cellular summaries and bounded oral material needs without assigning oral availability.
updates.boundary: Useful cellular access, oral availability and actual manufacturing cost remain unknown. Repeated source values across endpoints are retained as unresolved dependence.
updates.next_step: Measure native-parent cellular exposure/function and released-parent process recovery before ranking modifications or delivery approaches.

updates.title: Caffeine capture needs capacity as well as binding
updates.result: A reversible, finite-capacity model uses published buffer affinities to test capture and competition; equimolar host does not imply complete capture.
updates.boundary: Chosen buffer concentrations are not human exposures or doses. Paraxanthine capture, oral delivery, brain exchange and sleep recovery are unresolved.
updates.next_step: Qualify free-guest binding and intact accessible host in a physiological matrix before interpreting systemic capture.

updates.title: Relative spheroid response is not absolute function
updates.result: Reconstructed 48 paired insulin observations. The flow/vascular-bed condition has the highest mean relative stimulation index, but not the highest absolute stimulated output.
updates.boundary: These are source cell-line spheroids, not patient grafts. Donor, lot and circuit crosswalks are unavailable; the pairs cannot be counted as independent people.
updates.next_step: Link perfusion, identity, viability and function on the same constructs with their actual unit hierarchy.

updates.title: Separate repair endpoints do not establish joint success
updates.result: The joint-endpoint audit shows why separate favorable measurements cannot establish how many units satisfy every required repair condition.
updates.boundary: The illustrative endpoint counts are synthetic. Allele, cell and tissue-area denominators cannot be silently combined.
updates.next_step: Obtain joint observations with comparable denominators, unit IDs and the relevant functional outcome.
